# jpeglib real-world corpus manifest
# Format:
# id|path|source|license|mode|entry_points|expected|sha256
#
# The manifest is intentionally empty until LC2 lands real corpus samples.
# `tests/bin/jpeglib_real_world --allow-empty` validates the manifest shape for
# current release readiness; `tests/bin/jpeglib_real_world` requires entries and
# is intended for the library-complete gate.
